item.text: To book the room, first submit the dates and times you would like to use it. The booking team will then check whether the room is available during that period. You will receive a message confirming that your request was received. However, this message only confirms receipt; it does not mean your booking has been accepted. Your requested time is not approved until you receive a separate confirmation stating that the room has been reserved for you.
